evidence: Updates the vendored libsecp256k1 subtree with experimental BIP458 half-aggregation and BIP459 full-aggregation modules.
rationale: Vendors unmerged upstream libsecp256k1 modules (bitcoin-core/secp256k1#1566 and #1754) to provide signature aggregation primitives. Subtree updates for prospective cryptographic standards are worthwhile for testing and specification validation.
